contract: Microsoft IS functions inspect exact types without conversion. Array mapping follows that same existing scalar predicate. Raw Calc logical-array and invalid omitted-literal disagreements are retained, not translated into extra runtime states. No native Excel run is claimed.

report.method: Fresh OOXML snapshot for every check; hidden import, calculateAll, export; typed cached results. Empty input text is materialized as ="". No Poirot results are used.
report.scope: Scalar values only. Rebuilding snapshots verifies values after authored edits; cargo tests verify persistent invalidation and normal/overlay change lists.
